slot_convention.how_to_place: size the nail element to cell_width_frac_of_hand * hand width (aspect = cell), transform-origin at the sprite anchor (50% 92.5%), put that origin on `cuticle`, rotate(rotation_deg) clockwise. `center` is the same placement expressed as the cell centre (transform-origin 50% 50%).
